description.name: Twin Element Mode (Water, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Water]/[Attach Holy] after using a Water/Holy ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Arc
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Gentle Soul (0~2), removed after using Apex Gentle Soul two times

description.name: Apex Gentle Soul Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Gentle Soul level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Arc]

description.name: Apex Gentle Soul Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Gentle Soul level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Arc]
